_provenance.note: Arizona citation authorities. The CNAP Manual (dbmefaapolicy.azdes.gov) does not print short numeric section codes the way Illinois (PM/WAG NN-NN-NN), Michigan (BEM/BAM NNN), or Nevada (A-NNN) do — each topic page instead exposes a live breadcrumb outline position (e.g. 'FAA5.I Determining Benefits : 01 Determining NA Benefits : B NA Categorical Eligibility'). This pack cites the outline position itself, prefixed 'CNAP', e.g. 'CNAP FAA5.I.01.B' — reconstructed directly from each page's own breadcrumb, not invented. Federal 7 CFR citations are handled by the shared federal citation verifier and need no state-specific pattern here.
